3,661 likes, 247 comments - ishaanarora1 on June 29, 2024: "Ufff finallyyyy!! 🌚❤️ This might not sound believable but hear me out -

INSTAGRAM WAS THE LAST PLATFORM ON MY LIST WHEN I STARTED MAKING CONTENT!

It went like 
Quora then LinkedIn then YouTube and then Instagram.

I was super happy with my growth here but I always loved long form content because of the value it provides ❤️
Sadly LinkedIn and YouTube never grow at the same pace as IG. I didn’t celebrate 100,200,300K on IG but getting this play button means a lot to me ❤️

Making those 15-20 mins long videos sharing my experiences and then making people subscribe to it, makes me feel the best!! 

DEDICATED TO PROVIDING MORE SUCH CONTENT FOR YOU ALL BABIESSSS 😍❤️❤️

P.S -
1. Pls ignore the hair on my hand, drop in some cool waxing parlors 😂😂
2. I recd it almost 2-3 months back but couldn’t post it yet, jeez times have been busy but broooo it still feels so good.

Signing off (only to post again in the evening XD)
Ishhhhhh 🌚❤️

#youtube #growth #instagram #insta #viral #socialmedia".

posts.meta_description:
5,404 likes, 92 comments - ishaanarora1 on September 26, 2023: "I started-up with ₹1,500 at the age of 19. 💡

I remember I was in the 2nd year of my college and everyone around me were talking about either placements or MBA entrance prep, very few talked about startups. 🧠

Unfortunately those who did, had surrounded themselves with various negative thoughts that didn’t let them startup like -

• You need a lot of money to start-up.
• It’s better to start after experience.
• We need a remarkable idea then only we will get funding.

And the most common 9/10 startups fail.😮

My goal was just to give it a shot, until I fail. In the age group of 18-25 when you’ve no major responsibilities, you can literally do anything, fail at it and it still won’t matter much. 🤔

My major learning in the last 3-4 years?

It is literally not as hard as it is shown.
Do not care about what others are saying, just have faith in yourself and put in your 100% - More often than not you’ll be on the better side of things :)

I’ll post more about it here in the upcoming months ❤️

Plenty to unfold in the future 🙌🏻
Tagging some of my mentors you should genuinely follow - @iamsunnygarg @abvaidya @nimithagrawal @vivekk0609 @rohitmanglik @adi__arora @rishav_agarwal21 @yadavaj 

#startup #startups #entrepreneur #entrepreneurship #entrepreneurs".
